author: minerofthesoal
_comment_packageVersion: The Beat Saber build this mod is compiled against, which is whatever bs-cordl resolves to (4030.0.0 == 1.40.3_4614). If your headset runs a different 1.40.x build, QuestPatcher warns on install and lets you continue; the hooks bind by method name, not by offset. Change this and qpm.json's bs-cordl range together.
description: Pop-out YouTube live chat overlay for Beat Saber, standalone on Quest. Shows chat in the menu and during levels, signs in with your YouTube account (or a plain API key), and needs no PC or companion server.
